container.discovery: Direct lowercase kebab-case child directories containing brand.source.json

invariants: slug and brandVersion match across source, tokens, and manifest
sourceHash matches between tokens and manifest
every pack-managed artifact and asset declares a valid SHA-256 hash
the Brand Pack never lives inside a runtime-specific directory
the saved configuration points to the containing folder named brand, never to one slug directory
adding a valid sibling pack does not require a configuration change
the universal plugin never stores client-specific identity or learned rules
client-owned rules use their own schema and revision and are not added to the immutable build manifest
